definitions.explanation: A hollow cylinder for conveying liquids, gases, or other substances.
A tube with a bowl at one end for smoking tobacco.
A means of communication or connection between parties.

notes:
パイプ has three main uses from the English word "pipe."

PIPE/TUBE USAGE:
- ⟦{水道|すいどう}→水道：01058_suidou⟧パイプ (water pipe)
- ⟦{排水|はいすい}→排水：11104_haisui⟧パイプ (drainage pipe)
- ⟦ガス→ガス：01344_gasu⟧パイプ (gas pipe)
- ⟦パイプライン→パイプライン：noentry⟧ (pipeline)

SMOKING PIPE:
- パイプ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吸|す}う→吸う：04394_suu⟧ (to smoke a pipe)
- ⟦パイプタバコ→パイプタバコ：noentry⟧ (pipe tobacco)

CONNECTION/CHANNEL (figurative):
- パイプ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have connections/channels)
- パイプ⟦{役|やく}→役：12557_yaku⟧ (intermediary; go-between)
- This usage often implies unofficial or behind-the-scenes connections
